These terms apply when you use the SkipperCast website, app, feeds and downloads (“SkipperCast”). By using SkipperCast you agree to them. If you do not agree, do not use it.

1. Who may use SkipperCast

You must be at least 18 years old to use SkipperCast or create an account. SkipperCast is not directed to children.

2. A planning aid, not a navigation aid

SkipperCast is a trip-planning aid. It is not a navigation aid or a nautical chart and must not be used for navigation, collision avoidance, anchoring, or to decide whether a harbor entrance, bar or passage is safe. Maps, depths, habitat outlines, drift lines, bearings and exported waypoints can be incomplete, out of date, offset or wrong. Use current official charts, your vessel’s instruments and your own observation.

3. Forecasts and model output carry no guarantee

Wind, wave, current, temperature, comfort scores, habitat grades, search plans and alerts are estimates produced by computer models and automated processing of third-party data. They can be late, missing, stale or wrong, and actual conditions can differ sharply from any forecast. A good score or a “within your limits” alert is not a promise that conditions will be safe or that fish will be present. Check the official National Weather Service marine forecast and current observations before and during every trip.

4. Verify regulations with the authorities

Fishing regulations, seasons, bag and size limits, depth limits, marine protected areas and emergency closures change, sometimes with little notice. SkipperCast summarizes and links official sources but is not legal advice and is not an official source. Before you fish, verify the current rules with the California Department of Fish and Wildlife (CDFW) and, for federal waters and groundfish areas, NOAA Fisheries. You are responsible for complying with all laws that apply to you.

5. You assume the risks of boating and fishing

Boating and fishing at sea are dangerous and can cause injury, death and loss of property. You alone decide whether, when and where to go, and you are responsible for your vessel, its equipment, its crew and passengers, and for following the rules of the road. You voluntarily assume all risks of any trip you plan or take, whether or not you used SkipperCast.
